name: call
doc: the call's contract of the union solve's VJP (`union_backward_kernel`, csrc/fsla/src/entmax/entmax.cu): every width from 2 to 256, both alphas where the kernel has one, bf16 logits and route values and 1 to 16 levels. A list is alternatives, each its own context; a range is one context.

width.declared_by: docs/internals/entmax/entmax.md#the-contract: every width from 2 (ResolvedRouting refuses a level narrower, fsla/routing/types.py) up to MAX_BRANCH_WIDTH 256 is served by the arm of its padded width class

levels.declared_by: docs/internals/entmax/entmax.md#the-contract: one launch solves from 1 up to 16 levels, the level table's size; a deeper topology issues a second launch

alpha_tenths.declared_by: docs/internals/entmax/entmax.md#the-contract: the entmax exponents FSLA's activation registry holds are 1.5 and 2.0 (fsla/routing/activations.py), each its own context

logit_dtype.declared_by: docs/internals/entmax/entmax.md#the-contract: the logit plane is bf16: the library sends the solve bf16 logits alone (fsla/ops/produce.py, projection_dtype), and a plane of another dtype is refused

value_dtype.declared_by: docs/internals/entmax/entmax.md#the-contract: the route values are bf16, the stored form (docs/api.md), and a plane of another dtype is refused
